headline: Cultural Council discussed social media plans, member recruitment, grantee reception, and Folk Festival survey findings, with no formal votes taken.
summary: The council covered social media management and a possible intern program, recruitment of new council members, planning for the 2026 Lowell Artisan Market, and the grantee reception. It also reviewed Folk Festival survey data for FY27 local guidelines and discussed managing the group's email account, including a possible Slack workspace.
decisions: The council decided not to automatically give extra weight in scoring to the top category from the Folk Festival bead-survey; instead each member will weigh that data individually.

decision_evidence.quote: The council decided not to treat this as an automatic plus-one for events in a specific category. Instead, each council member will take the Folk Festival bead-survey data into consideration in their personal voting, weighting it according to how much they individually value that data.
